title: Assessing factors affecting Palestinian employees' turnover intention: a cross-sectional analysis
core_idea: Evaluate determinants of turnover intention among Palestinian employees, emphasizing differences between public and private sectors, using the 2020 labor force survey and logistic regression.
tldr: Study examines which factors are associated with Palestinian employees' intention to leave their jobs, comparing public and private sector differences via a cross-sectional analysis of 2020 survey data.
